sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN FRENCH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE - admission discontinued
lines: French Studies - Faculty of Arts and Social Science
Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2023. Students enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfilment of the module requirements by August 31, 2026.

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including both French 1911A/B and French 1912F/G, or French 1900E or French 1910 plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
1.0 course: French 2600E or both French 2605F/G and French 2606F/G.
1.0 course: French 2900 or both French 2905A/B and French 2906A/B.
0.5 course from: French 2805A/B, French 2806A/B (or the former French 2800), French 2907A/B.
1.0 course: French 3900 or both French 3905A/B and French 3907A/B.
1.0 course from two of the following three groups, with a maximum of 0.5 course per group: French 3540F/G-3542F/G, French 3560F/G-3562F/G, French 3570F/G/Z-3572F/G/Z.
1.0 course from two of the following three groups, with a maximum of 0.5 course per group: French 3580F/G-3582F/G, French 3600F/G-3602F/G, French 3690F/G-3692F/G.
1.0 course from two of the following three groups, with a maximum of 0.5 course per group: French 3610F/G-3613F/G, French 3720F/G-3722F/G, French 3750F/G-3753F/G.
1.0 additional course from 3500 level or above.
Note: French 2600E or both French 2605F/G and French 2606F/G are prerequisites for further studies in French Literature.
